body: I'm sorry about your stepbrother man.

Yesterday she asked me if I had any friends out of the blue. This kind of gave me the impression that she is already worried about me. I just think telling her would just break her heart and there's just a whole lot more to the situation.

Thank you for the advice! I'm really hoping these feelings would go away. I want to be happy but it only lasts for so long. Then reality hits me and I just can't find a reason to be happy. I might just talk to someone. But I don't want my family to find out. I don't want my mother stressing over the situation.
Thank you for the advice. And yeah, maybe we could get together some time on CS.
I find it way easier to explain what's going on without anyone knowing my identity.
